## Meeting Info
* [Dec 15, 2022, 16:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc-to-germany-berlin-united-kingdom-london-ny-new-york-city-ca-san-francisco-china-shanghai-japan-tokyo-australia-sydney/dec-2-2022/16-00)
* Duration: 60 minutes
* Recording: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOID9rklh4U

📅 Subscribe to the [Ethereum Protocol Call calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/1?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t) for calendar invites

### Agenda
* Client updates
* Compiler updates
* Spec updates
* Open Issues
  * header format
  * stack cleanup on `RETF` and `JUMPF`
  * disallowing unreachable code?
  * [EOF spec level open issues](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/eof1-checklist#Spec-level-Open-Issues)
* Shanghai Timeline 
* (time permitting): [banning code introspection](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eof-proposal-ban-code-introspection-of-eof-accounts/12113/12)

comments.body: Could [banning code introspection](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eof-proposal-ban-code-introspection-of-eof-accounts/12113/12) be added to the agenda? It seems necessary to avoid accumulating EOF versions over time in perpetuity (at least until the future EOF version where it is solved)
If we have time we should discuss, but currently the main priority is finalizing the last few pieces of the Shanghai EOF spec.
